title: SnowFall Scythe
description: This mod was requested by my friend for his SMP, SnowFall SMP, this is the mod for said SMP. This is a very simple mod, nothing much.
body:
# Snowfall Scythe
This specialized weapon serves as a powerful utility tool for players who prefer to keep their enemies at a distance. Instead of traditional melee strikes, the Scythe launches high-velocity snowballs that inflict Freeze damage. While the 3-second cooldown requires players to time their shots carefully, the ease of its crafting recipe makes it an accessible and essential item for early-to-mid-game survival.
